engine.format: gen9nationaldexag@@@Max Team Size = 3,Min Team Size = 3,Adjust Level = 50,Terastal Clause,Dynamax Clause,!Team Preview

metadata.interpretation: Fixed automatic policy outcomes, not human completion rates or 3v3 AI win rates; paired seeds are not independent samples

manifest.case_order: seed, team, policy, mode; each in listed order

config.information: run public state and p1 battle view only; no p2 view or private enemy build
config.recruit: first-public-candidate replaces lowest-current-absolute-HP slot, then earliest slot

limits.cutoff_rule: stop before an input at view.turn > limit
limits.decision_unit: public service operation attempts, including explicit resume

config.damage_score: literal-basePower * effectiveness * own-offensive-stat * accuracy * STAB * Technician * own-boost
config.information: own public build/resources, active revealed opponent id/types, public own move events only; no opponent moves/stats/ability/item
config.legality: training.observation.legal_mask and action_to_command; no action when ended/wait/no legal choice
config.own_ability_knowledge: own waterabsorb makes incoming Water type threat zero
config.public_species_knowledge: public opponent id rotomwash implies Levitate against Ground
config.technician: own canonical ability technician and literal basePower <= 60:1.5
config.tie_break: original switch slot ascending; request move index ascending
config.type_table: training.policies.effectiveness; differs from legacy fixture Psychic/Ghost immunity
config.wish_history: last own active move must be current active's Wish; own switch/drag/replace clears it

metadata.resource_metric: Journal HP/PP net changes and current own battle resources; not total damage or healing
